insights.title: 6 messages may need a personal reply
insights.finding: Some customers wrote about having a very hard time. These are flagged for care, not for marketing.
insights.why_it_matters: Responding with warmth builds trust. These words should never be used in campaigns.
insights.recommended_action: Reply personally and gently; where appropriate, share contacts for support services. Do not quote these messages.
insights.expected_impact: Trust and care for customers having a hard time

insights.title: Reels earn 3.0x the saves of static posts
insights.finding: Over the last six months, Reels averaged 72 saves and 2,595 reach per post, against 24 saves and 1,250 reach for static images.
insights.why_it_matters: Saves are the strongest signal that content is useful enough to come back to, and they push posts to new people.
insights.recommended_action: Turn your two best static posts of the month into short Reels (15 to 30 seconds), for example a scarf-tying tutorial.
insights.expected_impact: Around 3.0x more saves per post on the content you move to Reels
insights.measure: Track Instagram saves per post: 39.8 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Mission and community posts earn 2.3x the saves of other posts
insights.finding: Mission-led posts averaged 80 saves and 54 shares, against 36 saves and 14 shares for other posts. Only 17% of recent posts are mission-led.
insights.why_it_matters: Your mission is to normalise oncology headwear as an expression of style and identity, and contribute positively to the cancer community. This content serves it, and it is also what your audience values most.
insights.recommended_action: Make one in three posts mission-led: community voices (only with written consent), myth-busting and everyday style. Keep selling posts separate from care posts.
insights.expected_impact: More saves and shares, which grow reach without paid ads
insights.measure: Track Instagram saves per post: 39.8 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Customers are asking for a wider colour range
insights.finding: 14 of about 22 detractors in the last 12 months mention colour or design range. 110 Instagram comments asked for new colours or prints.
insights.why_it_matters: Limited choice is the main reason people would not recommend you, and it is easy to test before investing in stock.
insights.recommended_action: Run a two-option colour poll in Stories, then pre-order the winning colour in a small batch before committing to full production.
insights.expected_impact: Fewer detractors and a reason for past customers to buy again
insights.measure: Track NPS: 58 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: 27 partnership enquiries are waiting for a reply
insights.finding: 48 comments came from associations, pharmacies or hospital staff asking to collaborate; 27 have no reply yet.
insights.why_it_matters: Pharmacies and patient associations are a route to people who never search for you online.
insights.recommended_action: Reply to each one this week with a short partnership one-pager; pick two pharmacies for a three-month trial.
insights.expected_impact: New sales channel and community reach
insights.measure: Track Comment questions answered: 52.4% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: 66% of customers have bought only once
insights.finding: Of 1,512 customers, 34% have ordered two or more times.
insights.why_it_matters: A second purchase is far cheaper to win than a new customer, and many customers need more than one piece.
insights.recommended_action: Send a warm, care-first email 30 days after purchase (how to wash, how to style, a new colour) to everyone, never based on assumptions about anyone's health.
insights.expected_impact: A few points more repeat purchases lifts revenue without ad spend
insights.measure: Track Repeat purchase rate: 39.9% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Bamboo is your best-loved fabric (4.5 out of 5)
insights.finding: Bamboo products average 4.5 stars from 144 reviews, against 4.1 for other fabrics. Reviewers mention softness and comfort most.
insights.why_it_matters: Leading with what people already love is the lowest-risk way to grow.
insights.recommended_action: Lead product pages, ads and the 'first purchase' email with bamboo; test new colours in bamboo first.
insights.expected_impact: Higher conversion on your hero products
insights.measure: Track Average review rating: 4.26 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: October brings 1.9x your usual orders
insights.finding: In October you average 212 orders against a monthly average of 111. The next October starts in 313 days. It coincides with Breast Cancer Awareness Month.
insights.why_it_matters: Your busiest month brings attention and demand. Stock-outs or rushed content waste it.
insights.recommended_action: Plan October in August: stock bestsellers, line up partners and prepare content in advance.
insights.expected_impact: Capture the peak without stock-outs
insights.measure: Track Orders: 168 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: People are unsure about sizing
insights.finding: 117 comments asked about sizes and 3 pieces of feedback describe fit problems in the last 12 months.
insights.why_it_matters: Uncertainty about fit stops people buying online, especially for children.
insights.recommended_action: Add a simple size guide with head measurements (adults and children) to every product page and pin a Story highlight.
insights.expected_impact: Higher conversion and fewer returns
insights.measure: Track Website conversion rate: 2.4% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Posting regularly lifted reach by 73%
insights.finding: Since the week of 2026-03-02 you have posted 2.8 times a week (before: 1.3). Average reach per post rose from 1,024 to 1,775.
insights.why_it_matters: Consistency is the cheapest growth lever you have. Algorithms and people both reward a reliable rhythm.
insights.recommended_action: Protect the rhythm: batch-create two weeks of posts in one session and schedule them, so busy weeks do not break the streak.
insights.expected_impact: Keeps reach growing; avoids losing the gains
insights.measure: Track Weeks with at least one post: 100.0% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: We hear too little from children's line customers
insights.finding: Children's line is 17% of what you sell but only 4% of the feedback you receive.
insights.why_it_matters: Decisions based on the loudest or most digital customers can miss real needs. Parents buying for children rarely leave reviews.
insights.recommended_action: Ask children's line customers directly: a two-question card in the parcel with a QR code to your feedback form, worded for parents and carers.
insights.expected_impact: Balanced evidence before product decisions
insights.measure: Track Share of positive feedback: 83.8% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Phones bring 76% of visits but convert 2.5x less
insights.finding: Mobile visitors convert at 1.7% against 4.3% on desktop.
insights.why_it_matters: Most of your audience arrives from Instagram on a phone, so small fixes to the mobile shop pay back quickly.
insights.recommended_action: Test checkout on your own phone; enable Shop Pay or Apple Pay and shorten product pages on mobile.
insights.expected_impact: Closing half the gap would add roughly 35 purchases in this period
insights.measure: Track Website conversion rate: 2.4% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Market stalls: caja (€) up 49% in the last three months
insights.finding: Caja (€) reached €5,652 in the last 90 days, against €3,785 in the 90 days before and +208% on the same months last year.
insights.why_it_matters: This comes from a file you added yourself, so it fills a gap the standard exports do not cover.
insights.recommended_action: Keep a regular presence where it is growing, and bring QR cards to collect feedback in person.
insights.expected_impact: Better decisions about offline channels
insights.measure: Track the same total over the next three months in your own file.

insights.title: 30% of orders are gifts
insights.finding: About 30% of orders in this period mention a gift in the order notes.
insights.why_it_matters: Gift buyers are friends and family: a different audience with different questions.
insights.recommended_action: Add a gift option (wrapping, a note card, a gift card) and a short 'choosing a gift' guide.
insights.expected_impact: Higher order value and a new audience
insights.measure: Track Average order value: €56 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Revenue down 23% on the previous period
insights.finding: €9,489 in last 4 weeks, against €12,334 in the period before.
insights.why_it_matters: Knowing whether a change is seasonal or caused by something you did helps you repeat or fix it.
insights.recommended_action: Open Sales to see which products and channels moved, then note what you changed in the Plan's learning log.
insights.expected_impact: Clarity on what is driving sales
insights.measure: Track Revenue: €9,489 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Emails are not followed by more orders
insights.finding: Across 48 campaigns, the three days after sending averaged 10.5 orders, close to the usual 11.0.
insights.why_it_matters: If email does not move sales, the time spent on it could go elsewhere, or the emails need a clearer reason to buy.
insights.recommended_action: Test one email with a single product and a clear offer, and compare the next three days.
insights.expected_impact: Clarity on whether email is worth the time

insights.measure: Track Orders: 168 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.expected_impact: Keeps reach growing; avoids losing the gains
insights.measure: Track Weeks with at least one post: 100.0% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: We hear too little from children's line customers
insights.finding: Children's line is 17% of what you sell but only 4% of the feedback you receive.
insights.why_it_matters: Decisions based on the loudest or most digital customers can miss real needs. Parents buying for children rarely leave reviews.
insights.recommended_action: Ask children's line customers directly: a two-question card in the parcel with a QR code to your feedback form, worded for parents and carers.
insights.expected_impact: Balanced evidence before product decisions
insights.measure: Track Share of positive feedback: 83.8% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Phones bring 75% of visits but convert 1.7x less
insights.finding: Mobile visitors convert at 1.9% against 3.2% on desktop.
insights.why_it_matters: Most of your audience arrives from Instagram on a phone, so small fixes to the mobile shop pay back quickly.
insights.recommended_action: Test checkout on your own phone; enable Shop Pay or Apple Pay and shorten product pages on mobile.
insights.expected_impact: Closing half the gap would add roughly 316 purchases in this period
insights.measure: Track Website conversion rate: 2.4% over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Market stalls: caja (€) up 49% in the last three months
insights.finding: Caja (€) reached €5,652 in the last 90 days, against €3,785 in the 90 days before and +208% on the same months last year.
insights.why_it_matters: This comes from a file you added yourself, so it fills a gap the standard exports do not cover.
insights.recommended_action: Keep a regular presence where it is growing, and bring QR cards to collect feedback in person.
insights.expected_impact: Better decisions about offline channels
insights.measure: Track the same total over the next three months in your own file.

insights.title: 29% of orders are gifts
insights.finding: About 29% of orders in this period mention a gift in the order notes.
insights.why_it_matters: Gift buyers are friends and family: a different audience with different questions.
insights.recommended_action: Add a gift option (wrapping, a note card, a gift card) and a short 'choosing a gift' guide.
insights.expected_impact: Higher order value and a new audience
insights.measure: Track Average order value: €56 over the last 4 weeks. Add it to the plan and review it after 4 to 8 weeks.

insights.title: Emails are not followed by more orders
insights.finding: Across 48 campaigns, the three days after sending averaged 10.5 orders, close to the usual 11.0.
insights.why_it_matters: If email does not move sales, the time spent on it could go elsewhere, or the emails need a clearer reason to buy.
insights.recommended_action: Test one email with a single product and a clear offer, and compare the next three days.
insights.expected_impact: Clarity on whether email is worth the time

integrations.name: Shopify
integrations.auth: OAuth through a Shopify app installed on the store (never a password)
permissions: read_customers (optional, emails are anonymised on arrival)
integrations.limits: Orders older than 60 days need the read_all_orders scope, which Shopify must approve. API rate limits apply.
integrations.approval: Create a Shopify Partner app. Public apps go through Shopify app review; a custom app for one store does not.
integrations.upload: Orders, Products or Customers export (Shopify admin, Export, CSV)
guide: In Shopify admin, open Settings, then Apps and sales channels, then Develop apps (allow custom app development if asked).
Create an app called 'Insight Hub'. Under Configuration, Admin API scopes, tick read_orders and read_products. Save.
Click Install app, then reveal the Admin API access token once and copy it.
Paste the token and your shop address (your-store.myshopify.com) here. No Shopify review is needed for your own store.

integrations.name: Amazon Seller Central
integrations.auth: Selling Partner API authorisation (Login with Amazon OAuth) plus AWS request signing
permissions: Product reviews are not available through the API
integrations.limits: Personal buyer data needs extra Amazon approval and is restricted. Reports arrive with a delay of up to 24 to 72 hours.
integrations.approval: Register as an SP-API developer and complete Amazon's data protection review.
integrations.upload: Business Reports or Order report (Seller Central, Reports, CSV)

integrations.name: WooCommerce
integrations.auth: WooCommerce REST API keys created by the store owner, stored only on the server
integrations.limits: The site must be reachable over HTTPS.
integrations.approval: No platform approval needed.
integrations.upload: Orders export (WooCommerce, Analytics, Download CSV)

integrations.name: Etsy
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE
integrations.limits: Some buyer information is not shared with third-party apps.
integrations.approval: Etsy must approve the app before production use.
integrations.upload: Orders CSV (Shop Manager, Settings, Options, Download data)

integrations.name: Klaviyo
integrations.auth: OAuth for Klaviyo apps, or a private API key created by the owner and kept only on the server
integrations.limits: Attribution follows Klaviyo's own attribution window.
integrations.approval: Public OAuth apps need Klaviyo app review.
integrations.upload: Campaigns export (Analytics, Campaigns, Export CSV)

integrations.name: Mailchimp
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.0
integrations.limits: Revenue only if Mailchimp e-commerce tracking is set up.
integrations.approval: Register an app in Mailchimp.
integrations.upload: Campaign report export (Reports, Download CSV)

integrations.name: HubSpot
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.0 (public app) or private app token on the server
integrations.limits: Available data depends on the HubSpot subscription tier.
integrations.approval: Marketplace listing needs HubSpot review.
integrations.upload: Any HubSpot report exported as CSV

integrations.name: Instagram

permissions: instagram_manage_comments (needed to read and reply to comments)
data: Posts and Reels with reach, likes, comments, saves, shares and views

data: Videos with views, likes, comments and shares

integrations.name: Shopify
integrations.auth: OAuth through a Shopify app installed on the store (never a password)
permissions: read_customers (optional, emails are anonymised on arrival)
integrations.limits: Orders older than 60 days need the read_all_orders scope, which Shopify must approve. API rate limits apply.
integrations.approval: Create a Shopify Partner app. Public apps go through Shopify app review; a custom app for one store does not.
integrations.upload: Orders, Products or Customers export (Shopify admin, Export, CSV)
guide: In Shopify admin, open Settings, then Apps and sales channels, then Develop apps (allow custom app development if asked).
Create an app called 'Insight Hub'. Under Configuration, Admin API scopes, tick read_orders and read_products. Save.
Click Install app, then reveal the Admin API access token once and copy it.
Paste the token and your shop address (your-store.myshopify.com) here. No Shopify review is needed for your own store.

integrations.name: Amazon Seller Central
integrations.auth: Selling Partner API authorisation (Login with Amazon OAuth) plus AWS request signing
permissions: Product reviews are not available through the API
integrations.limits: Personal buyer data needs extra Amazon approval and is restricted. Reports arrive with a delay of up to 24 to 72 hours.
integrations.approval: Register as an SP-API developer and complete Amazon's data protection review.
integrations.upload: Business Reports or Order report (Seller Central, Reports, CSV)

integrations.name: WooCommerce
integrations.auth: WooCommerce REST API keys created by the store owner, stored only on the server
integrations.limits: The site must be reachable over HTTPS.
integrations.approval: No platform approval needed.
integrations.upload: Orders export (WooCommerce, Analytics, Download CSV)

integrations.name: Etsy
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE
integrations.limits: Some buyer information is not shared with third-party apps.
integrations.approval: Etsy must approve the app before production use.
integrations.upload: Orders CSV (Shop Manager, Settings, Options, Download data)

integrations.name: Klaviyo
integrations.auth: OAuth for Klaviyo apps, or a private API key created by the owner and kept only on the server
integrations.limits: Attribution follows Klaviyo's own attribution window.
integrations.approval: Public OAuth apps need Klaviyo app review.
integrations.upload: Campaigns export (Analytics, Campaigns, Export CSV)

integrations.name: Mailchimp
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.0
integrations.limits: Revenue only if Mailchimp e-commerce tracking is set up.
integrations.approval: Register an app in Mailchimp.
integrations.upload: Campaign report export (Reports, Download CSV)

integrations.name: HubSpot
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.0 (public app) or private app token on the server
integrations.limits: Available data depends on the HubSpot subscription tier.
integrations.approval: Marketplace listing needs HubSpot review.
integrations.upload: Any HubSpot report exported as CSV

integrations.name: Instagram
integrations.auth: Meta Login (OAuth) through a Meta developer app
permissions: instagram_manage_comments (needed to read and reply to comments)
data: Posts and Reels with reach, likes, comments, saves, shares and views
integrations.limits: Insights are kept for a limited time (about two years). Story insights expire after 24 hours. Personal accounts are not supported.
integrations.approval: Meta App Review and Business Verification are required before other businesses can connect.
integrations.upload: Content export (Meta Business Suite, Insights, Content, Export) or comments export

data: Videos with views, likes, comments and shares
Watch time where the API provides it

integrations.upload: Content analytics export (TikTok Studio, Analytics, Download data)

Which products get the best reviews?.answer: Gorrito Arcoíris bambú gets the best reviews: 5.00 out of 5 from 4 reviews. At the other end, Turbante Alba algodón averages 4.03. Only products with 3 or more reviews are compared.
Which products get the best reviews?.method: Average star rating per product across all reviews, products with at least 3 reviews.

When should we post?.answer: Tuesday is your best day: posts get a 10.56% engagement rate on average across 10 posts. Posts between 21:00 and 24:00 do best (10.09%). Days with fewer than 3 posts are not compared.
When should we post?.method: Average engagement rate ((likes + comments + saves + shares) / reach) by weekday and three-hour block.

Why did sales dip in January?.answer: Revenue fell 32% in January 2026 (€5,093) compared with December (€7,523). Orders changed by -35% (129 to 84). Average order value moved from €58.32 to €60.64. The biggest change came from Online store (-€1,655). The month before included Christmas, a seasonal peak, so a drop afterwards is expected.
Why did sales dip in January?.method: Compared total order value in January with December, then broke the difference down by sales channel.

What do customers complain about?.answer: The most common complaint is about colour and design range (11 negative mentions), followed by shipping and delivery (8). For example: "Echo de menos más colores, la gama es limitada." / "Pocos colores para elegir, ojalá hubiera tonos más vivos."
What do customers complain about?.method: Counted themes in feedback marked negative by the sentiment rules (or a low rating).
